name: 轻型救援盔

Render as if authored at 48x48 pixels with the complete object fitting the central 40x40 and 4-pixel transparent safety margins. You may output larger but retain genuinely coarse pixel shapes suitable for downscaling. Show an empty helmet in a slightly elevated front-three-quarter product view, no head or person. Fully transparent background, isolated object only. Upper-left light, restrained realistic desaturated palette. No background scene, no floor, no text, no numbers, no UI border, no rarity colored backdrop, no ground shadow, no glow, no photorealism, no modern futuristic accessories. Important: do not crop any straps or object edges. A clear recognizable single game icon, consistent with retro 1990s pixel inventory equipment.
